item.title: Invading armies, subterfuge and conquest: How fire ant wars affect ecosystems
item.description: Ants disperse seeds, scavenge, turn soil and serve as a food source in their ecosystems. If local ants are displaced by invasive ants from elsewhere, the effects are widely felt.

item.title: Federal judges in Colorado are fed up with ICE re-arresting the same immigrants
item.description: A federal judge in Colorado has found ICE in contempt for ignoring court orders to not immediately re-arrest detainees they've ordered released.
